data.question_title: A boggy of uniformly moving train is suddenly detached from train and stops after covering some distance. The distance covered by the boggy and distance covered by the train in the same time has relation
data.explanation_txt:
Let 'a' be the retardation of boggy then distance covered by it be S. If u is the initial velocity of boggy after detaching from train (i.e. uniform speed of train).

\(v ^ { 2 } = u ^ { 2 } + 2 a s \Rightarrow 0 = u ^ { 2 } - 2 a s \Rightarrow s _ { b } = \cfrac { u ^ { 2 } } { 2 a }\)

Time taken by boggy to stop,

\(v = u + a t \Rightarrow 0 = u - a t \Rightarrow t = \cfrac { u } { a }\)

In this time t distance travelled by train \(= s _ { t } = u t = \cfrac { u ^ { 2 } } { a }\)

Hence, ratio is given as \(\cfrac { s _ { b } } { s _ { t } } = \cfrac { 1 } { 2 }\)

data.question_title: \( \lim _ { x \rightarrow a } \cfrac { \sqrt { 3 x - a } - \sqrt { x + a } } { x - a } = \)
data.explanation_txt:
\[ \begin{align} & \lim _ { x \rightarrow a } \cfrac { \sqrt { 3 x - a } - \sqrt { x + a } } { x - a } \\ & = \lim _ { x \rightarrow a } \cfrac { \sqrt { 3 x - a } - \sqrt { x + a } } { ( x - a ) } \times \cfrac { \sqrt { 3 x - a } + \sqrt { x + a } } { \sqrt { 3 x - a } + \sqrt { x + a } } \\ &= \cfrac { 2 } { 2 \sqrt { 2 a } } = \cfrac { 1 } { \sqrt { 2 a } } \end{align} \]

OR:

Using L-Hopital's rule,

\[ \begin{align} & \lim _ { x \rightarrow a } \cfrac { \sqrt { 3 x - a } - \sqrt { x + a } } { x - a } = \lim _ { x \rightarrow a } \cfrac { 3 } { 2 \sqrt { 3 x - a } } - \cfrac { 1 } { 2 \sqrt { x + a } } \\ & = \cfrac { 3 } { 2 \sqrt { 2 a } } - \cfrac { 1 } { 2 \sqrt { 2 a } } = \cfrac { 1 } { \sqrt { 2 a } } \end{align} \]

data.question_title: Zinc reacts with very dilute nitric acid to give:
data.explanation_txt:
REACTION OF ZINC WITH NITRIC ACID:

  • very dilute acid: \( Zn + 10HNO_3 \to Zn(NO_3)_2 + NH_4NO_3 + 3H_2O \)
  • dilute acid: \( 4Zn + 10HNO_3 \to 4Zn(NO_3)_2+N_2O+5H_2O\)
  • moderately concentrated acid: \(3Zn + 8HNO_3 \to 3Zn(NO_3)_2+2NO+4H_2O \)
  • concentrated acid: \(Zn + 4HNO_3 \to Zn(NO_3)_2 + 2NO_2 + 2H_2O \)

data.question_title: Most of us use the products of science – railways, airplanes, electricity, wireless and thousands of others without thinking how they came into existence. We take them for granted, as if we were entitled to them as a matter of right. And we are very proud of the fact that we live in an advanced age and are ourselves so very ‘advanced’. Now there is no doubt that our age is a very different one from previous ages and I think it is perfectly correct to say that it is far more advanced. But that is a different thing from saying that we as individuals or groups who are more advanced. It would be the height of absurdity to say that because an engine- diver can run an engine and Plato and Socrates could not, the engine driver is more advanced than, or is superior to, Plato or Socrates. But it would be perfectly correct to say that the engine itself is a more advanced method of locomotion than Plato’s chariot was.
